target_conventions.normal: float16[H,W,3]; camera-space unit normal facing camera, not intrinsic outward orientation; zero outside mask
target_conventions.depth: float16[H,W]; positive orthographic camera distance 3-z in normalized object coordinates; zero outside mask
target_conventions.normal_training_note: Convert to float32 and optionally renormalize after float16 decoding; use foreground mask for losses
target_conventions.surface_strength: Displacement bound before fixed base-object bounding-sphere normalization; not image blur

scope: Synthetic family/detail and same-object different-view evaluation; not fresh-natural-image accuracy
